purpose: Define common polling-input sufficiency before any complete historical replay score is examined.
independenceDefinition: Distinct pollster or commissioning/source family after duplicate and overlapping-sample review; repeated releases from one family do not satisfy source diversity.

weighting.age: existing exponential half-life from the frozen polling model
weighting.sample: existing effective-sample weighting capped by the frozen model
weighting.sparseUncertainty: inflate the polling-state covariance when eligible observations or independent source families are below the full-information reference; never fabricate a share
weighting.missingObservation: a missing party category remains missing or grouped residual, never numeric zero

noEligibleObservation: A broad pre-registered prior may be constructed for diagnostic purposes, but the cycle remains non-runnable until the minimum evidence rule passes.
